name: metric-strip
title: Metric strip
description: A joined strip of three to five metrics: label, a figure that eases to new values, the change in an arrow and a word, and an honest dash when data is missing.
docs: Pass three to five metrics. `change` is a ratio (0.042 is up 4.2 percent); `null` means there is nothing to compare with, and `value: null` means no data, with `missing` saying why. Keep `format` objects stable so figures ease instead of restarting. While `loading`, pass the metrics you already have and the skeleton draws the same rows, so the strip keeps its height.
